Ideally positioned in Irvine’s Financial District, this newly built third-floor home offers approximately 1,405 square feet of beautifully designed living space, featuring an expansive one-bedroom floor plan and two bathrooms.

From the moment you enter, the open-concept layout creates a sense of space and effortless flow. The designer kitchen is beautifully appointed with premium GE Monogram stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, contemporary cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, and an oversized island with a built-in sink—equally suited for quiet mornings or entertaining guests.

The spacious primary suite is a private sanctuary, featuring a generous walk-in closet, plantation shutters, noise-reducing windows, and a luxurious spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, a freestanding soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. A convenient guest half bath adds an extra touch of sophistication. An in-unit laundry closet with a full-size washer and dryer completes the thoughtful design.

Open the doors to your private balcony and take in beautiful city-light views while enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding beneath the evening sky. Two dedicated parking spaces provide added convenience.

Life at Lexington is truly resort-inspired. Residents enjoy an approximately 8,000-square-foot clubhouse and recreation center, junior Olympic saltwater pool, three outdoor spas, state-of-the-art fitness center, half basketball court, and pickleball court. Additional amenities include a gated dog park, private cabanas, BBQ areas, outdoor fireplaces, flat-screen TVs, foosball and ping-pong tables, outdoor workspaces, and EV charging stations.

Beyond the community, an exceptional location puts you just minutes from Newport Beach, Fashion Island, John Wayne Airport, and the 405 Freeway. Enjoy walkable access to acclaimed dining and everyday conveniences, including North Italia, Houston’s, and Mother’s Market. A pedestrian bridge currently under construction will further enhance connectivity between Lexington and the nearby shopping center.

Sophisticated, stylish, and exceptionally well located, Lexington at Central Park West offers more than a home—it offers a lifestyle.

This 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home offers 1,196 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space featuring rich hardwood floors throughout, a fully updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, and a cozy fireplace in the living room.
Step out from the living room onto your private balcony and enjoy the serene surroundings of one of Irvine's most established neighborhoods. 
The in-unit laundry area adds everyday convenience, while the rare combination of an attached 1-car garage PLUS a detached 1-car garage provides exceptional storage and parking, a true luxury in condo living.
Located within the award-winning Irvine Unified School District with Canyon View Elementary, Jeffrey Trail Middle School (rated 10/10), and Northwood High School all minutes away. NO Mello-Roos and low HOA of just $200/month that includes access to pools, spa, tennis courts, BBQ areas, and lush green parks.
Conveniently situated near the Irvine Spectrum, major freeways (5 & 133), Jeffrey Road shopping, and some of Orange County's best dining and entertainment. Conventional, FHA, and private financing all welcome.
This is Irvine living at its finest. Top schools, no Mello-Roos, and a move-in ready home waiting for its next owner.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully designed contemporary end-unit condominium built in 2021, ideally situated in the highly sought-after Great Park Neighborhoods of Irvine. Offering 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a thoughtfully designed three-level floor plan, this home perfectly combines modern style, comfort, and functionality.
Upon entering the home, you'll find a versatile flex space on the first floor—ideal for a home office, fitness room, study area, or creative workspace to suit your lifestyle.

The second level features a bright and open Great Room concept with abundant natural light thanks to its desirable end-unit location. The spacious living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and the gourmet kitchen, complete with a large center island, modern cabinetry, and generous counter space—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.

The third floor offers a private and comfortable retreat with a spacious primary suite, featuring its own ensuite bathroom. A secondary bedroom, an additional full hallway bathroom, and a conveniently located laundry area complete the upper level.

Enjoy the exceptional lifestyle that Great Park Neighborhoods has to offer. Just a short stroll away is Navel Park, featuring expansive green lawns, open space, a clubhouse, picnic and barbecue areas, and recreational amenities for residents of all ages.

Conveniently located with easy access to major freeways, shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and entertainment, this home also belongs to the award-winning Irvine Unified School District, making it an outstanding choice for both homeowners and investors.

Residents enjoy access to the exceptional Great Park Neighborhoods lifestyle, including all community pools, parks, clubhouses, playgrounds, sports courts, trails, and resort-style amenities throughout the master-planned community. Just a short stroll away, Novel Park offers expansive green space, a clubhouse, picnic and barbecue areas, and recreational amenities for residents of all ages.

results.remarks:
Modern architecture, a bright open interior, and thoughtful finishes come together at this turnkey 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome offering approximately 1,320 square feet. Built in 2019, the three-level residence has a distinctive contemporary exterior, abundant windows, recessed lighting, and a clean neutral palette that makes the home feel fresh and inviting.

The main living space features an open floor plan with warm-toned flooring and plenty of natural light. The streamlined white kitchen is finished with quartz countertops, generous cabinetry, stainless steel ENERGY STAR appliances, a six-burner gas range, and an extended counter with room for casual seating. Just beyond the living area, a sliding glass door opens to a covered private balcony, creating an easy spot to enjoy fresh air.

Both bedrooms offer comfortable retreats, while the primary bath stands out with dual sinks, quartz counters, and a spacious walk-in shower. An upper-level laundry area with an included stackable washer and dryer adds everyday convenience. Additional highlights include central air, energy-efficient equipment, a tankless water heater, double-pane insulated windows, smart doorbell/camera, and an attached two-car tandem garage with direct access.

Living in Great Park adds an impressive collection of amenities just beyond your front door, including parks, biking trails, playgrounds, a dog park, pools and spa, pickleball and tennis courts, sport courts, barbecue and picnic areas, and clubhouse facilities. The Novel Park setting makes it easy to enjoy Irvine’s outdoor-focused lifestyle while still coming home to a polished, modern space.

Come experience 130 Tenor in person and see how its modern design, functional layout, and Great Park location fit your lifestyle.

results.remarks:
Dramatic ceilings, a private interior atrium, and thoughtfully updated living spaces define this inviting Irvine home. The bright and open living area features soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, recessed lighting, a fireplace, and rich wood-look laminate flooring that continues through the main living spaces. The adjacent dining area is highlighted by a dramatic high ceiling and contemporary statement lighting.

The updated kitchen features white shaker-style cabinetry, quartz-style countertops, generous cabinet and counter space, and a convenient pass-through opening connecting the kitchen with the living area. Double-pane vinyl windows and sliding doors bring in abundant natural light while giving the home a clean, updated feel.

A standout feature is the private interior atrium, accessible directly from the living area and primary bedroom. Recently finished with new tile flooring, this secluded outdoor space provides an ideal setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, entertaining, or creating a private garden retreat. A cozy front patio provides an additional outdoor space and a welcoming entry to the home.

The spacious primary bedroom enjoys direct access to the atrium, while the bathrooms feature updated vanities and fixtures. Additional highlights include recessed lighting throughout, ample storage, an interior laundry area, and a detached two-car garage.

Conveniently located in Irvine's desirable University Park area, the home offers easy access to neighborhood amenities, parks, shopping, dining, UCI, and highly regarded Irvine schools. A unique combination of dramatic architecture, two private outdoor spaces, tasteful updates, and an exceptional Irvine location.

results.remarks: This beautiful Irvine townhome offers an excellent location and floorplan. Upon entering, you'll notice the open layout and wonderful natural light. Tiled flooring extends throughout the entry, kitchen and dining areas and the soaring ceiling highlights the living room. The kitchen features light oak cabinetry, ceramic tiled counters, recessed lighting, and a garden window. The spacious living room is accented by a fireplace with tiled hearth and has a slider leading to the private patio...perfect for growing herbs and tomatoes. A half bath and direct access to the 2-car garage completes the lower level of the home. Upstairs you will find the laundry closet as well as 2 bedrooms, each offering in-suite bathrooms, vaulted ceilings, and ample closet space. The HVAC system has also been recently upgraded. In the community, there are two pools and spas. In addition, the Westpark HOA provides access to four parks, pools, sports courts, etc. The Las Palmas community is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, freeways, John Wayne Airport, and excellent schools.

- Step inside to discover a bright, open floor plan featuring tasteful upgrades throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The functional layout includes dual primary suites upstairs, each with its own private bathroom, plus a convenient guest powder room on the main level.
- Enjoy resort-style living with access to community amenities including a sparkling pool, spa, beautifully maintained greenbelts, walking paths, and lush mature landscaping. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, downsizing, or looking for an excellent investment opportunity, this beautifully updated home delivers the perfect combination of location, lifestyle, and value.

*Don't miss your chance to own a turnkey home in the heart of Irvine!

results.remarks:
Presenting one of the finest fully remodeled single-level residences available in Irvine's highly sought-after Woodbridge community. This exceptional upper-level Beacon model in the desirable Stonegate neighborhood has been extensively renovated with premium materials, timeless finishes, and meticulous attention to detail, creating a truly turnkey home that stands apart from anything else in its price range.

Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings, rich hardwood flooring, fresh designer paint, elegant plantation shutters, recessed LED lighting, custom wood millwork, solid-core interior doors, ceiling fans, and a beautiful marble fireplace that anchors the light-filled living room. The open floor plan flows seamlessly to a private balcony—perfect for morning coffee, evening relaxation, or entertaining guests.

The stunning chef's kitchen has been completely reimagined with custom hardwood cabinetry featuring soft-close doors and drawers, gorgeous quartz countertops, full-height designer tile backsplash, premium Frigidaire stainless steel appliances, Kohler sink and faucet, and abundant storage. The spacious primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, mirrored wardrobe doors, and a beautifully appointed en-suite bath featuring a Kohler enameled cast-iron tub, frameless glass shower enclosure, premium stone surfaces, designer lighting, and luxury Kohler fixtures. The secondary bath has been finished with the same uncompromising quality.

Additional upgrades include dual-pane Low-E energy-efficient windows, a premium insulated steel front entry door, Baldwin Venetian Bronze hardware, matching designer hardware throughout, energy-efficient HVAC with programmable smart thermostat, USB/USB-C outlets, premium lighting, quiet bath exhaust fans, and an indoor laundry room complete with side-by-side washer, dryer, and linen storage. Beyond the home itself, enjoy the unmatched Woodbridge lifestyle with access to 24 pools and spas, two private lake beach clubs, dozens of parks, tennis courts, pickleball courts, basketball courts, miles of walking and biking trails, and the award-winning Irvine Unified School District. Woodbridge continues to be recognized as one of Irvine's most desirable master-planned communities for its exceptional amenities and quality of life.

This is more than a home—it's a rare opportunity to own a beautifully crafted, move-in-ready residence where virtually every detail has already been upgraded for years of carefree living. NO MELLO ROOS.

results.remarks: Set in the highly desired Great Park community, this contemporary townhome offers bright, open living with two bedroom suites, resort-style amenities, and top-rated Portola High School and Solis Park K-8 barely a quarter mile away. A gated front patio welcomes you home, and a formal foyer connects to storage closets and the two-car garage with epoxy floors. The main level opens into living and dining space that flows into the kitchen, where the center island makes a natural spot to gather. Quartz countertops pair with white cabinets, designer lighting, and stainless appliances to keep the kitchen light and functional. Sliding doors open to your private balcony, an easy extension of the living area. Upstairs, a recessed nook along the way makes a cozy place to read. Both bedrooms are true suites with private full bathrooms and walk-in closets. results.remarks:
OPEN, PRIVATE & EXCEPTIONALLY WELL LOCATED! A standout setting within Irvine’s Great Park, this beautifully upgraded Tri Pointe home enjoys an open frontage with no residence directly across—offering enhanced privacy and a refreshing sense of openness rarely found in attached-home living. Even better, it’s just 2 minutes by car or approximately a 15-minute walk to The Canopy, Irvine’s highly anticipated 12-acre retail and dining destination featuring T&T Supermarket, In-N-Out and more, and approximately a 12-minute walk to The Pools, Great Park’s impressive 8-acre aquatic park.

Thoughtfully designed across three levels, this home features 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a spacious flex den, and a side-by-side 2-car garage with EV charger outlet. The first floor offers a versatile den—perfect for a home office, gym or bonus room—with direct access to a rare private patio featuring abundant sunlight and a higher privacy wall.

The second floor opens to an expansive living, dining and kitchen space designed for comfortable everyday living and entertaining. The upgraded kitchen features white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, soft-close drawer tracks, a newer dishwasher, plus a newly updated sink and faucet. A private balcony further extends the living space outdoors.

The third floor is dedicated to two private bedroom suites, each with its own en-suite bath. The primary suite features a walk-in closet, mountain views and added tranquility with no directly shared bedroom wall. Easy-maintenance hard-surface flooring runs throughout the home, with plush carpeting reserved for the staircase for added warmth and comfort.

Additional improvements include newer third-floor flooring, epoxy garage flooring, updated bathroom faucets and more. With nearby walking trails, easy I-5 access, and Great Park’s exceptional parks, pools and recreation just moments away, this home offers a rare combination of openness, privacy, thoughtful upgrades and outstanding walkability.

results.remarks:
Welcome to a stunning single-level corner penthouse residence built in 2020, in the highly sought-after Novel Park neighborhood of Irvine’s award-winning Great Park community. Rarely available and ideally positioned in a premium location, this remarkable home overlooks the beautifully landscaped park and tranquil water feature below, creating a peaceful setting that’s as impressive as it is inviting.  The coveted corner location fills the home with abundant natural light while showcasing picturesque park views from nearly every room. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by an open, thoughtfully designed floor plan featuring designer tile flooring, expansive windows, and a sophisticated chef’s kitchen complete with quartz countertops, a large center island, and abundant cabinetry. The spacious great room flows seamlessly into the dining area and private covered balcony through oversized sliding glass doors, creating the ideal indoor-outdoor living experience for entertaining, relaxing, or simply enjoying the spectacular surroundings. With views this beautiful, the landscape itself becomes the artwork.
Designed with both comfort and privacy in mind, the desirable single-level floor plan places the luxurious primary suite on one side of the home. The retreat features a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, an oversized shower, and a generous closet. On the opposite wing are two spacious secondary bedrooms and a beautifully appointed full bath, providing an ideal layout for family, guests, or a home office. A separate laundry room is conveniently located just off the kitchen.  Storage is abundant throughout, including a large double-door storage closet on the balcony, a private adjacent storage room, a spacious tandem two-car garage, and access to the building’s dedicated bike storage room.
Living in Great Park means enjoying one of Orange County’s premier master-planned communities, offering resort-style pools and spas, parks, playgrounds, clubhouses, fitness centers, sports courts, playing fields, scenic walking and biking trails, coffee shops, community events, and the popular farmers market—all just moments from your front door.  Rarely does a home combine a desirable single-level floor plan, premium corner penthouse location, spectacular park views, abundant natural light, and exceptional community amenities. This is more than a home—it’s a lifestyle defined by comfort, sophistication, and one of the finest locations in Novel Park.

results.remarks: Welcome to an exceptional opportunity in Irvine’s highly desirable Deerfield community. Offering 1,688  square feet of beautifully remodeled living space, this end-unit townhome features three bedrooms, a spacious loft, and a versatile floor plan designed for today’s lifestyle. Step inside to a bright, refreshed interior filled with natural light from expansive dual-pane windows, complemented by approximately 30 recessed lights, luxury vinyl flooring, and designer-selected paint throughout. The open living and dining areas are anchored by a stylish built-in electric fireplace, while the generous dining space easily accommodates larger gatherings. The remodeled kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, quartz countertops, a full backsplash, stainless steel appliances, an oversized sink, updated range hood, and a convenient breakfast bar overlooking the adjoining family room. This flexible space can also function as a home office, playroom, or additional lounge area. Large sliding glass doors open to a private patio with direct access to the detached two-car garage, complete with a newer garage door and motor. A convenient powder room and additional storage are also located on the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers its own electric fireplace, an oversized window, and a wall-to-wall closet system with updated sliding doors. The remodeled primary bathroom features quartz countertops and dual vanities, while two additional well-sized bedrooms, an updated hallway bathroom, and a generous loft complete the second floor. Deerfield residents enjoy beautifully maintained greenbelts and mature landscaping along with access to five pools, spas, tennis courts, a racquetball court, sport court, clubhouse, and outdoor cooking areas. Ideally located near neighborhood schools, Culver Plaza shopping and dining, UC Irvine, Irvine Spectrum, South Coast Plaza, the I-5 and I-405 freeways, and Orange County beaches, this move-in-ready home combines comfort, convenience, and tremendous value in the heart of Irvine.

Designed for easy single-level living, the living room, dining area, kitchen, and all bedrooms are conveniently located on the same floor, creating a comfortable and highly functional layout.

With its extensive recent updates, impressive ceiling height, abundant natural light, privacy, and convenient Irvine location, this move-in-ready home offers an ideal combination of comfort, functionality, and easy everyday living.
